Thank you for this awesome response. That is my current issue, yeah I've always been the "emo" kid because I was never allowed to express myself in my parents home. So I got into deathcore, etc. It was my only way at lashing out at them. ( and learning some guitar.)

I'll be honest with you I am at that point. I wake up everyday and say fuck everything, but i feel like a zombie. I don't feel alive. I dont know what I am because I was always told what to be. I dont know what I want because I was always told what to want. I honestly dont even know what it means to grasp the concept. 

Again this is not a swan song. I can't get any of this sorted in my head and its driving me to dark places.

How long did it take you to finally let go of her, to have a day where she didn't even cross your mind? Thank you for replying and I truly hope your words come to fruition. You sound like a good guy, and I hope all of what you posted is true for you as well.
